title: GadgetsHub microSD research sheet
method: Plain curl requests (default curl user agent, 2s spacing) to official brand sites only; no Amazon/Flipkart fetching. Search URLs are constructed, not fetched.
excluded: Geonix 64GB A2 V30 150/70 MB/s (shop's own stock card) - documented elsewhere, not researched.

blockedHosts.images.samsung.com: all Samsung product photos (gallery front / adapter / pack) - allow to download recorded image URLs
blockedHosts.api.sandisk.com: SanDisk live price/stock data for India PDPs
blockedHosts.indiastore.sandisk.com: SanDisk India store (seller STPL) - possible INR prices
blockedHosts.static.sandisk.com: SanDisk site scripts/fonts (product images themselves are on www.sandisk.com)
blockedHosts.www.kingston.com: not attempted - known to block automated requests

variants.speedNote: Per-capacity speeds from India page disclosure #9 (64GB: up to 170 read/80 write; 128GB: 190/90; 256GB-1TB: 190/130), which match the global page spec table.
